name: Project Status Update
description: An internal or client-facing project status update or 3P update

required_sections.title: Header
required_sections.description: Project name, report date, reporting period, author, status RAG (Red/Amber/Green)

required_sections.title: Summary
required_sections.description: 2–3 sentences on overall status and most important item this period

required_sections.title: Progress
required_sections.description: What was accomplished since last report

required_sections.title: Plans
required_sections.description: What is planned for the next period

required_sections.title: Problems / Risks
required_sections.description: Issues, blockers, and risks with owners and actions

optional_sections.title: Decisions Needed
optional_sections.description: Items requiring stakeholder decision or sign-off

optional_sections.title: Key Metrics
optional_sections.description: KPIs or delivery metrics relevant to stakeholders
